patch_description: Avoid recomputing the full `weight / logcnt` matrix for every added replica. The greedy replication policy only changes the per-replica load of the selected logical expert in each layer, so maintain that value incrementally. This preserves the exact expert selection and replica ranks of the existing algorithm while reducing replication from O(num_redundant * layers * num_logical_experts) division work to O(num_redundant * layers) updates plus the required reductions.
